races.title: State House, District 54
races.note: Unopposed: this seat was decided without a general-election contest, so it won't be on your ballot.

cands.name: Randy Maggard
cands.bio: Dade City Republican, born 1963; House member since a 2019 special election; chaired the Republican Party of Pasco 2006-12. Unopposed on the Nov. 3 ballot.
cands.local_ties: Born in Dade City, where he lives (Wikipedia).

record.text: Won a 2019 special election for HD 38; has represented HD 54 (east Pasco) since the 2022 redistricting.
Wikipedia notes a Florida Politics headline saying he proposed a 2026 bill seeking state control over water-quality and wetlands regulation.
Faced an Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary challenge from firefighter Michael Pultorak, who ran on growth issues.

endorsements.text: Endorsed Walter Price (HD 55) with Reps. Holcomb and Yeager, and Byron Donalds for governor (per Florida Politics headline).

cands.gaps: Primary result not confirmed in my sources (he is unopposed in November per the worklist). No donor reporting retrieved. The water-bill detail rests on a Wikipedia line; I did not open the Florida Politics article. Owner sources: only alexjoneslive.com on-site search was run for this name (no results); stewpeters.com, rumble.com and infowars.com on-site searches are bot-blocked and the web-search budget ran out, so those were not checked.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
Online Protections for Minors: restricts social media accounts for minors.
Interests of foreign countries: restricts land purchases near military sites and critical infrastructure by people from China and other 'countries of concern'.
Education: expands school voucher eligibility to all Florida K-12 students.
Heartbeat Protection Act: bans most abortions after six weeks of pregnancy.
Public Safety: lets most adults carry a concealed firearm without a permit (permitless carry).
Property Insurance: creates the Florida Optional Reinsurance Assistance program (FORA) for insurers.
Building Safety (condo safety response after Surfside).
